claims.statement: The summarize stage selects between agy (default) and agno backends as a pure function of config.summary.backend via get_summarize_backend, and the Notion publish path is backend-specific: agy publishes via its own Notion MCP as part of its run, while agno publishes directly via the Notion REST API with no MCP and no model tool-calling.

summarize and notion are treated as one manifest-coupled stage pair: the orchestrator skips the summarize backend only when both summarize and notion are already complete, and marks both complete in the same step after a successful backend run.

Slide markdown is embedded in the summary prompt as reference context only, wrapped in a non-XML Markdown code fence produced by _fence_for so the prompt-injection surface is bounded; the slide content is kept out of the summarizing model's output budget and appended deterministically by the engine in append_slide_descriptions.

The agno backend produces a plain-text summary and a short digest with an Agno/OpenRouter model, the engine writes <name>.md + <name>.telegram.md (and <name>.slides-clean.md) first and then publishes the Notion subpage via publish_to_notion; a Notion failure fails the whole summarize+notion stage because the publish-record sidecar is written only after a successful publish.

The direct Notion REST publish extracts the parent page id from notion.parent_page_id (bare id or Notion URL), converts the Markdown summary into Notion block objects losing nothing, creates the subpage in ≤100-block chunks, and, when cleaned slide descriptions are non-empty, creates a 'Slide Descriptions' child page under the summary page.

Both backends produce <name>.md (source of truth for the summary) and <name>.telegram.md (the short digest preferred by the telegram stage, with a full-summary fallback when the digest is missing/empty); the agno path additionally writes <name>.slides-clean.md and the <name>.notion_published.json publish-record sidecar.

Selection has no silent cross-backend fallback: an unknown summary.backend raises ValueError, and selecting agno without the optional agno extra raises an actionable AgnoImportError; the agno path is hard time-bound by the summarize-stage timeout (timeouts.summarize when set, else timeouts.agy) with the blocking Notion publish run in a worker thread.
